articles.author: Kirsten Korosec
articles.title: Google is bringing a more personal version of its Gemini AI assistant to your car - TechCrunch
articles.description: Google is bringing Gemini's Personal Intelligence feature to cars, allowing its AI assistant to draw on information from Gmail, Calendar, Maps, YouTube, and other Google services to deliver more personalized responses while driving.
articles.content: Google is making the Gemini AI assistant that’s already in millions of cars, trucks, and SUVs a lot more personal a move that could push consumers even deeper into the company’s ecosystem of products… [+2090 chars]
